response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and build/CI infrastructure, but the resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or leading organizational change. His titles are all IC-track (Senior/Staff Software Developer/Engineer) rather than management roles, and there's no mention of managing teams, setting team priorities, or conducting one-on-ones, which are core requirements for this Level II management position.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, testing frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and CI/CD infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript)
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and Code Kata/Refactoring Dojo sessions
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience (no direct reports, no performance management mentioned)
Career path is consistently IC-focused (Senior/Staff Developer) with no formal 'Lead' or 'Manager' titles
No evidence of leading organizational change or strategic roadmap ownership at a team/org level

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
